solution_text:
1. Cast Quarry Hauler. Target Kiora with its ETB ability, and tick her up to 8 counters.
2. Use Kiora's -8 ability. When the three Octopi enter the battlefield, have two of them fight one Metalwork Colossus, and the third fight your own Festering Mummy. One Colossus dies, as does your Mummy.
3. When Festering Mummy dies, use its trigger to put a -1/-1 counter on anything except either of your 2-power creatures. That counter triggers Hapatra's ability to create a 1/1 Snake with deathtouch.
4. When the 1/1 Snake token enters the battlefield, Kiora's emblem is still active, so you can have it fight the remaining Colossus. Since it has deathtouch, Colossus down.
5. With the way clear, swing to victory for 4 damage with Hapatra and Weaver of Currents!
